title: validation event
description: Event-log line written when the owner answers ok (or go on a plan-gate kind whose go publishes). core checks the latest one before every publish.

actor.description: Only the owner validates; never a chat tool, the butler or a run.

publish_sha256.description: Hash of the canonical JSON of the block's publish list; publish is refused when it no longer matches.

dropped_by.description: Event id of the message that dropped it (validation_dropped only).
